title: Virtual Assistant - Privacy & Data Protection Roles
description:
Job Application Virtual Assistant – Privacy & Data Protection Roles

Job Overview



I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support my job search by identifying, tracking, and applying to relevant roles on my behalf.



The focus of this search is privacy and data protection roles specifically. I am not looking for broad risk, audit, cybersecurity, or general compliance applications unless the role is clearly centered on privacy, data governance, AI governance, or data protection.



The ideal candidate has prior experience helping professionals apply to jobs through platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, company career pages, and recruiter portals.



This role requires strong attention to detail, good judgment, and the ability to follow exact application criteria. Quality is more important than volume.



Target Role Focus



Applications should be focused on roles related to:



Data Privacy Analyst

Senior Data Privacy Analyst

Privacy Compliance Analyst

Privacy Program Analyst

Privacy Program Manager

Data Protection Analyst

Privacy Governance Analyst

AI Governance Analyst

Responsible AI / AI Compliance Analyst

Privacy Operations Analyst

Data Governance Analyst, only where privacy, data protection, or regulatory compliance is central

Vendor Privacy Analyst / Third-Party Privacy Review roles, only where the role is focused on personal data, DPAs, privacy reviews, or data protection requirements



The priority is to find roles aligned with privacy compliance, privacy program management, PIAs/DPIAs, AI governance, data governance, DSRs, vendor privacy reviews, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, and privacy-by-design. These areas match the direction of my resume and target job search.



Roles to Avoid



Please do not apply to general risk roles unless they are clearly privacy-related.



Do not apply to roles that are mainly focused on:



General enterprise risk management

Financial risk

Credit risk

Market risk

SOX/internal audit

IT audit

General cybersecurity analyst roles

Security operations/SOC roles

General third-party risk roles with no privacy or data protection focus

Insurance risk

Operational risk roles unrelated to privacy

Unrelated administrative roles

Sales roles

Very junior entry-level roles



If you are unsure whether a role fits the criteria, flag it for review before applying.



Core Responsibilities



Apply to a high volume of relevant jobs each week based on the criteria I provide.



Customize applications using my resume, cover letter templates, job-specific keywords, and role requirements.



Review job descriptions carefully to make sure the role is truly privacy, data protection, AI governance, privacy compliance, or privacy-focused data governance.



Track all applications in a shared spreadsheet, including:



Company name

Job title

Application date

Job link

Platform used

Status

Login/application notes

Follow-up needed



Monitor
 responses and flag interview requests, recruiter messages, assessments, or unusual responses for my review.



Assist with interview scheduling by coordinating available times on my calendar when instructed.



Maintain daily or weekly updates on application volume, responses received, and any questions.



Requirements



Proven experience supporting job applications for another person.



Strong English reading comprehension and attention to detail.



Ability to review job descriptions and determine whether the role matches specific criteria.



Experience applying through LinkedIn, Indeed, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, company portals, and similar systems.



Comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel to track high-volume applications accurately.



Able to work independently while following exact instructions.



Professional, discreet, and trustworthy, as this role may involve access to job search
, calendar, and application portals.



Must not exaggerate, misrepresent, or invent any information in applications.



Must be comfortable asking for clarification before submitting anything unclear.



Nice to Have



Prior experience as a job application VA, recruiting assistant, HR assistant, or career support assistant.



Familiarity with privacy, compliance, data governance, AI governance, legal compliance, or data protection job titles.



Experience tailoring resumes or cover letters based on job descriptions.



Experience tracking applications and recruiter responses in Google Sheets or Excel.



Fast turnaround and consistent daily communication.



Volume & Timeline



This is ongoing weekly work.



Target volume: 150–200 relevant applications per week, depending on role quality and availability.



Quality matters. I do not want random or low-quality applications just to hit a number.



Daily check-ins are required with a summary of applications submitted, responses received, roles flagged for review, and any questions.



Important Instructions



You must only apply to roles that match the criteria provided.



Do not apply to broad risk, audit, cybersecurity, or unrelated compliance roles unless the role is clearly focused on privacy, data protection, AI governance, or privacy-related data governance.



Do not answer application questions incorrectly or make up experience.



If an application asks for salary expectations, sponsorship, relocation, demographic information, assessments, references, or anything unusual, flag it for my review before submitting.



Confidentiality is required.



To Apply



Please briefly answer the following:



What experience do you have helping someone apply to jobs?

What platforms have you used before? For example: LinkedIn, Indeed, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, company websites.

How do you track and manage high-volume applications?

How many applications can you complete per week while still maintaining quality?

Have you worked on applications for privacy, data protection, compliance, AI governance, legal compliance, or data governance roles before?

How do you decide whether a job is relevant or not before applying?

What is your availability and preferred work schedule?



Please only apply if you have done this type of work before and are comfortable following detailed instructions.

We are a premier manufacturer specializing in high-end custom furniture, draperies, and window coverings, serving an elite clientele that includes luxury residential clients, commercial businesses, interior designers, and world-class casinos and resorts. With a reputation for exceptional craftsmanship, attention to detail, and bespoke design solutions, we are seeking a skilled Virtual Office Manager to keep our operations running smoothly behind the scenes.

We are seeking a highly organized and self-motivated Virtual Office Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our company. You will work remotely to manage the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of our business — from tracking employee time and processing payroll, to coordinating installation schedules and client meetings, to ensuring our team has the supplies they need. This is a role for a proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced, detail-driven environment and takes ownership of the tasks that keep our business running at the highest level.

Key Responsibilities

1. Employee Time Tracking

• Monitor employee time records using our time-tracking platform (Connecteam), ensuring all hours are logged correctly and consistently and otifying employees when they’ve reached their hours for the week.

• Review and audit timesheets on a weekly basis, flagging discrepancies and following up with employees or managers to resolve issues promptly.

• Ensure maintenance of records of PTO, sick leave, and overtime in our payroll platform (ADP), ensuring compliance with company policies.

• Generate and distribute time-tracking reports to management as needed.

2. Payroll Processing

• Coordinate and process weekly payroll accurately and on time, using the company’s payroll software (ADP).

• Ensure all payroll inputs — including hours worked, adjustments, bonuses, and deductions — are verified before submission.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll questions and resolve discrepancies in a timely and professional manner.

• Coordinate with external accountants or HR providers as necessary.

3. Scheduling of Installations & Client Meetings

• Own the master calendar for product installations, coordinating seamlessly between the production team, installers, clients, project managers, and designers.

5. General Office Administration

s, and messages, routing inquiries to the appropriate team members promptly.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and/or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail).

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and polished demeanor.

Preferred Qualifications

Work Structure & Compensation

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Ministry Reels (IG / TikTok / YouTube Shorts)
description:
I create ministry-focused long-form video content — sermons, teachings, interviews, worship moments, and faith-based lifestyle content — and need a skilled editor who can pull out the most powerful, shareable moments and transform them into scroll-stopping short-form Reels.

This is not a basic captions job. The content carries spiritual weight, and I need someone who can honor that while still editing for platform performance — strong hooks, tight pacing, and full visual polish across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

Deliverable: 4 finished Reels per week.



What You'll Do



Watch long-form ministry footage and identify the most impactful 30–90 second moments — convicting, inspiring, or quotable

Edit for retention: hook in the first 2 seconds, tight pacing, no dead air

Add burned-in animated captions (bold, clean, readable)

Apply color grading for a warm, modern, platform-native look

Add music or sound design that complements the message (not distracts from it)

Create 9:16 vertical exports optimized for IG Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Match the style, pacing, and energy of reference videos I provide

Deliver within 48 hours of receiving footage, with revisions within 24 hours





What I'm Looking For



Strong short-form portfolio — Reels or TikToks edited in the last 60 days; ministry, faith, or motivational content preferred

Full polish skills: motion graphics, color grading, sound design — not just cuts and captions

Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro

Understands what makes content stop the scroll AND what honors the message

Experience with mixed ministry content — sermons, teachings, interviews, worship, testimony

Reliable communicator — responds within 24 hours, meets deadlines every week

Comfortable working from reference videos and replicating format and tone

Preferred: familiarity with Christian/faith-based content — understanding of tone, terminology, and sensitivity matters here





What I Provide



Raw footage per batch

Reference Reels showing the exact style, pacing, and format I want

Branding assets (fonts, colors, logo if applicable)

Clear, specific feedback early on to dial in the style together





How to Apply

Low-effort applications will not be reviewed.

Send me:



Your name and a 2–3 sentence intro on why you're a great fit

3–5 links to short-form Reels or TikToks you've edited — ministry or faith content is a big plus

The software you use

Your per-video rate

Your typical turnaround time

title: YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)
description:
# YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)



## Position Type



Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor



---



## About This Role



We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow.



---



## Compensation



Per-package pricing (no video = no pay):



**Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):**

- $50 per video package

- Includes:

  - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime)

  - 5–7 short-form vertical clips

  - 1 custom thumbnail



**Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):**

- $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries

- Based on quality, reliability, and communication



**Additional standalone shorts:**

- $5 each

- $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required



**Payment Schedule:**

- Every 2 weeks

- Only for packages actually delivered and approved



---



## About The Channel



This channel focuses on:



- mortgages

- real estate

- financial education

- wealth-building concepts



The editing style should feel:



- modern

- clean

- high-retention

- professional

- trustworthy



The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing.



We want viewers to feel:

*"Clear, calm, confident guidance."*



Style references:



- Graham Stephan

- Ali Abdaal

- Mark Tilbury



---



## What You'll Be Editing



You will primarily edit:



- talking-head educational videos

- financial storytelling content

- mortgage strategy content

- real-world buyer scenarios



Typical long-form videos:



- 5–10 minutes



You will also create:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok clips

- LinkedIn vertical clips



---



## Responsibilities



### Long-Form Editing



You will:



- remove mistakes, pauses, filler words

- tighten pacing for retention

- add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts

- add clean captions and text emphasis

- add occasional b-roll and overlays

- integrate provided infographics and visuals

- use light background music and subtle sound design

- maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style



### Short-Form Content



From each long-form video:



- identify strong hook moments

- create 5–7 vertical clips

- format properly for 9:16 platforms

- add captions and pacing optimized for retention

- create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video



**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

- consistent with channel branding



### Visual / Graphics Work



You may occasionally:



- add simple motion graphics

- integrate charts and infographics

- use stock footage selectively

- organize visuals to improve understanding



Most visuals and scripts will be provided.



---



## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT meme editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.



---



## Included Resources



You will usually receive:



- raw footage

- script

- topic context

- visual references

- infographic assets

- branding direction



---



## Required Skills



- YouTube editing

- Short-form editing

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of pacing and retention

- Good English comprehension

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

We are a US-based company specializing in recruiting and onboarding Independent Business Owners (IBOs). We handle lead generation and provide our team with pre-qualified, appointment-based leads — no cold calling involved.

We're looking for a female Closing Specialist with outstanding English skills to join our team on a full-time basis. Your job will be to handle inbound and scheduled closing calls with pre-qualified leads throughout the day. Your mission: convince prospects to join our program.

- Handle a high volume of scheduled closing calls daily with pre-qualified leads (no cold calling — ever)

- Clearly explain the IBO program and its benefits to US-based prospects

- Build rapport and trust quickly so prospects feel comfortable sharing personal details

- Guide prospects through the sign-up and onboarding process

- Stay organized while managing multiple leads and follow-ups simultaneously



What We're Looking For



- Female candidate preferred

- Excellent spoken English — near-native fluency, neutral or American-leaning accent

- Strong persuasion and rapport-building skills

- Trustworthy, warm, and professional phone presence

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks and leads at once

- Previous experience in closing, sales, or high-trust phone roles is a strong plus

- Comfortable working US business hours



Compensation

$1,200 USD/month (fixed salary)

- Experience as a Team Lead or Subject Matter Expert is a major plus

- Strong background in building and improving operational processes, not just executing them

- Experience coordinating remote or distributed teams across multiple tasks and time zones

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Slack, Airtable, Notion, Asana, or similar operations tools

title: Solar Permitting Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

NRG Clean Power is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Solar Permitting Coordinator to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between our design team, project managers, local municipalities (AHJs), and utility companies. You will be responsible for preparing, submitting, and tracking all necessary permit applications to ensure our solar projects are approved accurately and efficiently. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Permit Preparation: Assemble and review permit application packages, including structural and electrical engineering designs, site plans, and required jurisdictional forms.



Submission & Tracking: Submit permit applications to local Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and Homeowners Associations (HOAs) via online portals, mail, or in-person delivery (expediting).



Interconnection Applications: Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications and track them through to the Final Permission to Operate (PTO) stage.



Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive working relationships with city planners, building departments, and utility representatives to facilitate smooth approvals.



Issue Resolution: Promptly address and resolve any permit rejections, plan check corrections, or requests for additional information by coordinating directly with internal design and engineering teams.



Data Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all permitting activities, milestones, and expenses within the company CRM Salesforce.



Reporting: Provide regular updates to project managers and sales teams regarding pipeline status and expected approval timelines.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum [1-2] years of experience in permitting, project coordination, or administrative roles within the solar, construction, or roofing industries.



Language Skills: Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively advocate for the company with local government officials and utility representatives.



Application & Tech Proficiency: Highly adept at learning and navigating various software applications, including online municipal permitting portals, utility interconnection platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.



Knowledge: Familiarity with local building codes, zoning laws, and AHJ requirements is highly preferred. Basic understanding of solar PV systems is a strong plus.



Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage complex paperwork and catch errors before submission.

title: Land Acquisitions Wholesale Real Estate FL
description:
Company Description:



We are a forward-thinking real estate investment firm based in Florida, USA. With a proven track record in residential properties, we are aggressively expanding our operations into the lucrative niche of land investing. We are looking for a highly experienced and autonomous Land Specialist to become the cornerstone of our land division.



Job Summary:



This is a senior-level opportunity for a VA who is a master of the land investment lifecycle. We are not looking for a general real estate assistant; we need an expert who lives and breathes land. You will be the engine room of our Florida land operations, responsible for everything from identifying undervalued parcels to structuring profitable seller financing deals that generate long-term cashflow. Your deep expertise in due diligence and creating notes will be critical to our success.



Required Tech Stack (Must Have Experience):




 (or sms campaign experience): Daily management of SMS campaigns.

PropStream & Zillow: Rapid market research and running comps.

County GIS Maps: Navigating local county sites for zoning, parcel boundaries, and utility checks.



Bonus Tech Stack (Highly Preferred, but will train):



BuyerBridge.ai: Finding builders and managing buyer lists.

Id.Land: Property mapping and evaluation.

Resimpli CRM: Lead and data management.

Land Insights: For advanced property data and evaluation.


: For rapid due diligence and parcel checks.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Deal Flow & Acquisitions:



* Lead Generation: Implement and manage marketing campaigns to generate a consistent flow of motivated land sellers.

* Lead Management: Immediately respond to and professionally handle incoming seller leads on SmarterContact. Filter for motivation and negotiate pricing.

* Land Analysis & Comping: Accurately determine the market value of raw land in Florida by rapidly analyzing comparable sales and market data.

* In-Depth Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive due diligence on every potential property using GIS and our tech stack, including:

* Verifying local Florida zoning regulations and land use restrictions.

* Confirming legal and physical access (easements, road frontage).

* Investigating utility availability (water, sewer/septic, electricity).

* Checking for wetlands, flood zones, topography issues, and other potential restrictions.

* Acquisitions: Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements with American sellers, with a strong focus on acquiring properties using seller financing.



2. Seller Financing & Dispositions:



* Structure Creative Deals: Architect and structure seller financing (note) terms for both buying land from original owners and selling it to end buyers.

* Pitch Seller Financing: Expertly explain the benefits of seller financing to property owners to get more deals accepted over cash offers.

* Dispositions & Buyer Relations: Market our land inventory for sale, primarily on terms, to generate cash flow and create valuable paper assets (notes). Utilize BuyerBridge.ai (if familiar) to connect with builders and buyers.

* Transaction Coordination: Prepare and coordinate the necessary documents to successfully close on the acquisition and disposition of properties.



Qualifications and Experience:



Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct, hands-on experience as a VA specifically in the US LAND INVESTING niche. (This is a strict, non-negotiable requirement).



Creative Finance Expertise: Demonstrable expertise in SELLER FINANCING. You must have extensive experience creating, pitching, and structuring notes for both the acquisition and disposition of land.



Mastery of Due Diligence: You must know exactly what to look for and what questions to ask to determine a property's true value and usability.



Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Florida markets and county zoning sites is highly preferred. Experience with RV Parks or Manufactured Homes is a huge plus.



Communication: Fluent English (Speaking and Writing). Exceptional negotiation skills; you must be confident and persuasive when building rapport on the phone.



Autonomy: Highly organized, systems-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously with zero hand-holding.



Bonus: Experience with selling performing notes to third-party note buyers.



What We Offer:



Premium Compensation: We offer a highly competitive base salary plus a significant performance-based bonus for every profitable deal you manage. Your income is directly tied to the value you create.



Leadership Role: You won't be just another VA; you will be a key leader in building our land business from the ground up.



Autonomy & Trust: We are looking for an expert we can trust to run the process. You will have the autonomy to make decisions and implement your strategies.



Long-Term Stability & Growth: This is a long-term position with a company that is committed to growing and investing in its team.



How to Apply:



If you are a true Land Investing Specialist who meets these demanding qualifications, we want to talk to you. Do not send a generic cover letter. Please submit your application with a customized cover letter that explicitly answers the following questions:



Describe your land due diligence process. What are the top 5 most critical things you look for before recommending the purchase of a rural, vacant land parcel?



Explain, as if you were speaking to a property owner over the phone, the benefits for them to sell their land to us using seller financing instead of waiting for a full cash offer.



How many years of experience do you have in Land acquisitions and dispositions?



Do you have experience with SmarterContact or Launch Control?



List one specific Florida county or city you have worked in previously.



Have you done any creative financing or seller financing deals? 



Do you have any experience with subdividing land or doing lot splits?



Do you also have experience with houses (not just land)? 



Applications that do not include thoughtful answers to these 5 questions will be immediately disqualified. This is your chance to prove your expertise. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: VFX / Motion Graphics Artist Needed for Cooking Videos — Ingredient Pop-Ups, PIP Overlays & Step Graphics
description:

This includes graphics such as:



* Picture-in-picture overlays

* Ingredient pop-ups

* Step-by-step instruction graphics

* Highlighting the “next step” while the current step is happening

* Simple animated callouts

* Timers or progress-style graphics when needed

The goal is to create a polished cooking video style where viewers can clearly see what is happening now and what step is coming next.

* Adding motion graphics to already-edited cooking videos

title: Local SEO Specialist - Google Business Profile & Map Pack Expert
description:
Who we are



Alloy Growth Partners is a U.S.-based growth agency that works exclusively with HOA management companies — the firms that professionally manage residential communities and homeowner associations across the country. It's a large, competitive, and underserved industry, and we're the only agency built specifically for it.



Our team brings 35+ combined years of experience inside this industry. We know it from the inside out — and we build marketing, SEO, and growth systems that actually move the needle for our clients. Our mission: growth should be engineered, not hoped for.



The role



We're looking for a full-time Local SEO Specialist who owns Google Business Profile performance end-to-end for our clients. You live in the local search landscape — map packs, GBP signals, local citations, ranking factors — and you have the results to prove it.



This is not a generalist SEO role. We need someone who has done the hands-on work of moving clients into the local 3-pack in competitive markets and keeping them there. You'll manage multiple client accounts, track and report on ranking progress, and work closely with our content and web teams to make sure every local signal is aligned.



A key part of this role is the ability to audit existing local SEO strategies — including diagnosing over-reliance on aggressive tactics — and build clean, sustainable ranking foundations that hold up long-term. If you've managed ranking transitions and know how to protect a listing while shifting strategies, that experience matters here.



What you'll own

— Manage, optimize, and monitor Google Business Profile listings for multiple HOA management clients across U.S. markets

— Build and execute local SEO strategies designed to move clients into and up within the local map pack

— Audit existing local SEO setups — assess signal quality, identify risk, and build transition plans where needed

— Audit and maintain local citation profiles — NAP consistency, duplicate listings, directory accuracy

— Develop and manage review generation systems; monitor and respond to reviews strategically

— Identify and resolve GBP issues, suspensions, policy violations, and ranking drops — fast

— Track ranking performance using local SEO toolsets; benchmark against competitors and flag opportunities

— Coordinate with content and web teams to align on-page local signals with GBP strategy

— Deliver clear, consistent ranking reports that translate data into action items — not just charts

— Stay current on Google's local algorithm updates, GBP policy changes, and industry developments

— Manage your workload and deadlines in 



What we're looking for



Non-negotiables

— 3+ years of hands-on local SEO experience with a provable track record of map pack results

— Deep, current expertise in Google Business Profile optimization — categories, attributes, posts, Q&A, photos, products, and beyond

— Real examples of moving clients into the local 3-pack in competitive markets — you must be able to show your work

— Experience managing GBP for multiple clients or locations simultaneously

— Proficiency with local SEO tools: BrightLocal, Whitespark, Semrush Local, or equivalent

— Strong understanding of local ranking factors — proximity, relevance, prominence, and behavioral signals

— Ability to audit existing strategies, identify signal risk, and manage clean ranking transitions

— Ability to diagnose ranking problems systematically and build clear remediation plans

— Fluent, professional English — written and verbal

— Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable across multiple client accounts



Strong pluses

— Experience in HOA management, property management, or real estate

— 
 or comparable project management platform experience

— Familiarity with local link building, geo-targeted landing pages, and local schema markup

— Experience troubleshooting GBP suspensions and reinstatement

— Knowledge of review platform integrations and automated review generation workflows



What working at Alloy looks like



We operate with clear systems, defined processes, and high accountability. Everyone on the team knows what they own, how success is measured, and how their work connects to client results. We move fast, communicate clearly, and don't tolerate ambiguity sitting unaddressed.



We're a remote team, which means you'll need to be self-directed and proactive — not waiting to be told what to do next. If you thrive with ownership and hate being micromanaged, you'll fit.



How to Apply

Please submit all of the following:



— Updated Resume (PDF format)



— 2–3 minute Introduction Video (Loom, Google Drive, or similar link)

Briefly introduce yourself

Share your experience with Local SEO and Google Business Profile

Highlight specific results (e.g., moving clients into the local 3-pack)



— Portfolio or Case Studies (if available)

Examples of GBP listings you’ve managed

Before-and-after results, rankings, or performance metrics



— Answers to the following questions:

Describe a time you moved a client into the Google local 3-pack. What was your strategy?

How do you audit a Google Business Profile and identify ranking issues?

What local SEO tools have you used, and how do you use them in your workflow?

nts from a podcast and turn them into short, punchy, engaging videos using smart editing, strong hooks, creative visuals, transitions, images, B-roll, graphics, and tight storytelling.



Role Overview



You will be responsible for creating 90 short-form video clips per month from our long-form podcast content.



Each clip should feel polished, engaging, and intentionally edited — not just auto-generated captions placed over a podcast clip. The clips tend to be between 20-60 seconds.



The target audience is experts, consultants and online coaches trying to get clients without social media. They are problem aware of not getting clients, and not succeeding on social media...but not yet solution aware that there are better ways (such as our method, 15-minute solo podcasts). The role of the short form content is to meet them where they're at, and make them more aware.



Responsibilities

1. Create Short-Form Podcast Clips



You will create 90 short-form videos per month from long-form podcast episodes.



Each clip should:



Capture a clear, valuable idea from the podcast

Have a strong hook, clear body, and satisfying payoff

Be edited for attention and retention

Feel unique, creative, and shareable

Be ready to post across short-form platforms



2. Edit for Punch and Clarity



You will be expected to:



Remove filler words, long pauses, and unnecessary gaps

Tighten the wording so each clip feels fast-paced and engaging

Rearrange or trim sections where needed to improve flow

Make each clip as short, sharp, and clear as possible

Ensure the opening hook grabs attention quickly for the target audience



3. Add Creative Visual Elements



We are not looking for basic AI clips with captions only.



Each video should include creative editing elements where appropriate, such as:



B-roll

Extra footage

Images

Graphics

Zooms

Transitions

Pattern interrupts

On-screen emphasis

Visual storytelling elements



The goal is to make the clip feel engaging and intentional, not generic.



4. Quality Control



Before submitting clips, you will need to make sure each video is:



Cleanly edited

Easy to understand

Visually engaging

Aligned with our brand and audience

Free from awkward cuts, errors, or unnecessary filler

Ready to publish



Compensation is $500 per month for 90 short-form video clips per month.



To apply, please submit:



1. A sample short video (as a shareable link for us to view) created from the podcast content provided here:









2. And a written justification as to why the hook appeals to our target audience (experts, consultants and online coaches trying to get clients without social media), and exactly what the payoff of the video is. This helps us understand how you think.



Applications that only submit an AI-generated clip with captions and no extra creativity, visuals, transitions, images, graphics, or editing effort will not be considered. To be considered, your submission must adhere to all of the standards mentioned above.

title: QC Specialist — Design & Preship
description:
QC Specialist — Design & Preship

Location: Remote

Schedule: Mon–Fri

Reports to: Production Manager



About the role

We're a dental lab in San Pedro Garza García hiring a detail-obsessed QC Specialist to own two

checkpoints: Design QC (before a case goes to mill/print) and Preship QC (before a case leaves the

lab). You're the last line of defense.



What you'll do

Design QC (pre-mill/print)

• Review CAD designs in exocad / 3Shape against the RX and scans

• Verify margins, occlusal clearance, minimum thickness, connector sizing

• Check contacts, emergence profile, pontic form, embrasures

• Confirm design matches prescribed material and indication

• Send clear, specific feedback to designers on rework



Preship QC (pre-ship)

• Verify shade against RX under controlled lighting

• Confirm RX matches the finished case — tooth #s, material, design, attachments

• Check occlusion on articulator (static and excursive)

• Inspect margins under magnification

• Verify interproximal contacts

• Evaluate surface texture, polish, glaze, and overall aesthetics

• Approve or route back with specific notes



Requirements

• 5+ years in a dental lab (crown & bridge, all-ceramics, or implants)

• Strong CAD skills — exocad and/or 3Shape

• Solid grasp of dental anatomy, occlusion, and prosthetic principles

• Hands-on with zirconia, lithium disilicate, PMMA, PFM

• Spots what others miss; gives direct, professional feedback

• Must speak and write English — you'll be reading US RX forms and communicating with the team in

English



Nice to have

• CDT or equivalent certification

• Prior QC lead or lead-tech role

• Implant experience (screw-retained, custom abutments, full-arch)

• Additional clinical experience — dental assistant, hygienist, or dentist background



Compensation

Competitive, based on experience

title: Social Media Manager (Content Strategy + Growth)
description:
We’re a collaborative, supportive, faith-centered boutique Design House passionate about creating beautiful and meaningful printed products for our clients - from mindful journals to dream planners to Christian devotionals and Bible Studies to self-care and mental wellness workbooks. Our heart is to create with clarity, intention, and excellence — serving both our clients and their audiences well. We’re growing and looking for someone who can help us share these stories of design and transformation with a wider audience.



We believe design and storytelling matter, and we’re looking for someone who can help us expand that message of excellence across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest,
, and beyond.





Role Overview



You’ll own the strategy, voice, and execution of our new social media presence while collaborating with our in-house design team (who will create the branded visuals). Your role is to plan, brief, post, and grow — ensuring our content not only looks beautiful, but is also consistent and connects deeply.



You’ll work closely with our founder and design team and own the strategy and execution of our social media, with responsibilities across four main areas:



1. Content Strategy & Planning

 • Build a monthly content calendar (posts, reels, carousels, stories).

 • Write warm, engaging captions in our brand voice & source inspiration / reference posts for our designers to create

 • Brief the design team on upcoming visuals that are needed (e.g. next week, we will need one carousel showing before/after, one client highlight, and one behind-the-scenes mockup)

 • Schedule posts (using tools like Later, Planoly, or Meta Business Suite)

 • Repurpose content across platforms (e.g., IG, TikTok, YouTube,
, Pinterest).

 • Suggest creative campaign ideas (series, themes, or challenges) that can help us stand out and connect wit our audience.



2. Community Engagement

 • Respond to comments and DMs with our warm but engaging brand voice ?

 • Proactively engage with aligned accounts and audiences (liking, commenting, sharing stories)

 • Build relationships in the journaling, planner, faith-based, and design communities

 • Nurture our small but growing community into loyal followers and future clients

 • Proactively seek collaboration opportunities with aligned voices, influencers, and accounts.



3. Growth & Analytics

 • Research and apply effective hashtags, trends, and posting times

 • Monitor analytics and share simple, actionable reports on what's working and what needs improvement.

 • Test and refine strategies to increase engagement and reach to broaden our audience

 • Stay updated on IG, TikTok, and other relevant platform changes



4. Conversion-Focused Strategy

 • Align social content with client launches, Hope & Sage updates, and future product drops

 • Write captions with clear CTAs that guide people to our contact form, site, or
 list

 • Collaborate with our future
 marketing strategy for cohesive campaigns





Requirements

 • Experience managing and growing social accounts (please share portfolio or examples).

 • Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok trends, and conversion-based content.

 • Ability to plan, schedule, and track performance.

 • Comfortable managing a content calendar 2–4 weeks ahead and coordinating with team

 • Excellent written English and ability to write warm, professional captions.

 • Comfort working with a faith-based brand.

 • Organized, self-starter who can take initiative and bring creative ideas.

 • Familiarity with Canva/Adobe (basic editing for resizing/formatting).





Bonus Points If You Have (Not required)

 • Basic video editing (simple reels, trimming, captions, transitions).

 • Experience in the design, stationery, journaling, wellness or Christian space.

 • Familiarity with paid ads/boosted posts.

 • An eye for premium aesthetics and understanding of premium design brands





 IG Accounts we Love:



To give you a sense of the quality and tone we’re aiming for, here are two accounts that inspire us:

 • Brandwell Designs: 

 • Horacio Printing: 



We’d love for our social presence to reflect a similar level of beauty, clarity, and intentionality — while still building our own distinct voice.





Hours & Pay

 • Potential to grow into a long-term, full-time role with more responsibility.





To Apply



Please send us:

 1. A short introduction about yourself and why you might be a good fit for our company and this role.

title: Proofreader & Quality Control Specialist – Design House
description:
We’re a collaborative, faith-centered boutique Design House passionate about creating beautiful, meaningful, and accurate journals, planners, and devotionals for our clients.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a detail-oriented Proofreader & Quality Control Specialist to ensure 100?curacy in our planners, journals, and devotionals before finalizing. This will include checking all dates and holidays in monthly, weekly, and daily planner spreads align with the corresponding year, cross checking scripture and quote references, and ensuring accuracy in products before we send to our clients. If you have an exceptional eye for detail, a methodical approach to reviewing documents, and a passion for ensuring error-free, high-quality work, we’d love to hear from you!



What You’ll Do:

• Proofread and verify all content within planners, journals, and other print products, ensuring accuracy in dates, US holidays, scripture references, and formatting.

•  Cross-check client revisions and ensure all requested edits have been properly implemented.

•  Compare documents side-by-side to catch any missing details before files are finalized.

•  Provide structured feedback to the Design & Data Entry Teams for any inconsistencies or errors.

•  Occassionaly check for consistency in typography, spacing, and layout across all pages.

•  Maintain an organized checklist system for quality control.



Who This Role is Ideal For:

•  Someone who notices even the smallest details and enjoys reviewing documents with precision.

•  A person who thrives in structured, process-driven work and enjoys ensuring consistency.

•  Someone with prior experience in proofreading, quality control, or meticulous document review (experience with planners, books, or print design is a bonus!).

•  A methodical thinker who can systematically check layouts and text and dates for alignment, accuracy, and clarity.



Who This Role is NOT For:

•  Someone who is easily distracted and struggles with repetitive, detail-heavy work.

•  Someone who prefers speed over accuracy. 

•  Someone who is looking for a creative design or strategic role—this position is about accuracy and precision, not creation or execution.

•  Someone who prefers loose, unstructured tasks—this role requires a systematic approach to checking details.



Requirements:

•  Strong attention to detail—you should be able to spot even the smallest inconsistencies.

•  Experience in proofreading, copyediting, or quality control.

•  Comfortable working with structured documents (planners, books, formatted PDFs, or InDesign files).

•  Familiarity with Google Docs, Adobe Acrobat (or PDF reviewing tools), and checklists for quality control.

title: Procurement and Sales Support Assistant
description:
We are a growing custom printed packaging company based in Vancouver, BC Canada, seeking a remote Procurement and Sales Assistant with mandatory prior experience in the printing and packaging industry (Do not apply if you have zero experience in this industry). This is a critical requirement and applicants without this background will not be considered. 



We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and detail-oriented individual to join our team. In this role, you will support both our procurement and sales functions by helping manage supplier communication, quotations, order coordination, lead follow-up, and day-to-day administrative support for the management team.



This position is ideal for someone who is proactive, resourceful, and confident communicating with both suppliers and potential customers. You must be able to work effectively in a remote environment, stay highly organized, and contribute to both cost-efficient procurement and sales growth.



Your primary responsibilities will include handling supplier quotations, coordinating shipping and production updates, supporting sales outreach, following up with leads, assisting with customer quotations, and ensuring smooth communication with our management team.



Key Responsibilities

Procurement Responsibilities



Procurement Strategy



Assist in implementing procurement strategies aligned with company goals, including sourcing, cost-saving initiatives, and supplier evaluation.

Research, evaluate, and communicate with suppliers to identify the best options based on price, quality, and lead time.

Support management in comparing vendor quotations and making purchasing decisions.



Purchase Management



Assist in the procurement of goods and services, ensuring timely and cost-effective purchases.

Prepare, review, and organize purchase orders, supplier quotations, and procurement requests.

Monitor order progress and follow up with suppliers on production timelines and delivery schedules.



Cost Control



Monitor procurement expenses and identify opportunities for cost savings.

Help ensure competitive pricing without compromising quality or service.

Maintain accurate costing records for management review.



Supplier Management



Communicate regularly with vendors regarding quotations, production, timelines, shipping, and issue resolution.

Build and maintain professional supplier relationships.

Coordinate supplier communication related to production, shipping, and logistics.



Quality Assurance

Outbound dial, text, and
 incoming marketing leads with extreme urgency (under 5 minutes).

Thick Skin & Persistence: You are energized by outbound dialing. Rejection does not phase you; you understand that sales is a volume game.

THE ROLE

This is a full-time, long-term position. We are not looking for someone to fill a calendar. We are looking for someone who understands that social media and design exist to build an audience, grow trust, and drive leads — and who can execute at a high level across all three skill areas below.



The right candidate will own our brand visuals, run our social channels consistently, and actively support marketing campaigns that generate real revenue. Over time, this role has a clear path to becoming our full Marketing Lead as we scale.



You will report directly to our founder and work closely with our Sales Director, Operations Manager, and marketing systems team.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Graphic Design

Design is the primary skill we are hiring for. If you cannot create clean, on-brand visuals from scratch — not just fill in Canva templates — this role is not for you.



• Create branded graphics for social media posts across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube

Social Media Management

You will run our weekly content pipeline end to end: creation, scheduling, moderation, and reporting.



• Plan and schedule 5 posts per week (Monday through Friday) across
, LinkedIn, and YouTube

 Group daily — approve members, moderate posts, and engage with the community

• Create and schedule guest announcement posts for our weekly masterclass guests

• Repurpose weekly coaching recordings into short-form clips, value posts, and newsletter content

• Manage and update our Google Business Profile

• Track follower growth, engagement metrics, and group membership weekly

• Generate a simple weekly social media report and share it with the team in Slack

• Flag performance issues or engagement drops with context and recommendations — not just data



Marketing Campaign Support

Top Rep runs Meta ad campaigns, webinars, and live bootcamp events that drive new client acquisition. You will support the execution side of these campaigns.



• Create promotional content and graphics for webinar and bootcamp campaigns

• Build on-screen CTA assets and QR codes for use during live webinars

• Draft and send outreach messages to potential podcast guests and influencer partners

• Support sponsor coordination for live events — sponsor page updates, communication, collateral

• Monitor basic campaign performance and flag results to the team

• Create post-event content — recap posts, testimonial graphics, highlight clips

• Manage the YouTube content topic pipeline to support a consistent upload schedule



Admin & Team Operations

• Keep Google Drive content folders organized and up to date

• Maintain posting trackers and content calendars in ClickUp

• Handle masterclass guest logistics — scheduling, pre-event
s, guest list management

• Create and maintain SOPs for your recurring workflows

• Participate in weekly team planning meetings



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You need daily check-ins or step-by-step instructions to complete recurring work

• You can schedule content but cannot design it from scratch

• You think of social media as just posting — we want someone who thinks about why it works

• You are looking for a short-term or project-based engagement

• You cannot write in natural, clear English — captions and LinkedIn posts are part of the job



REQUIREMENTS

Required

• At least 2 years managing social media for a brand, business, or organization

• Strong Canva skills with a portfolio of original branded work you can show us

• Good written English — you can write copy that sounds human, not templated

• Comfortable working independently in ClickUp or a similar project management tool

• Reliable internet and available to overlap with US Central Time business hours

• Long-term availability — this is a career position, not a side gig



Strong Preference

• Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM or funnel platforms

• Experience repurposing video content into short-form clips or reels

• Background supporting a US-based coaching, training, or education company

• Experience moderating live virtual events or webinars

• Experience with Gamma for training or presentation documents

• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager — even just reading dashboards



WHERE THIS ROLE GOES

We are actively building out our marketing function. Right now we need strong execution. Over time, we want someone who can grow into owning our marketing strategy — campaign planning, content direction, and performance analysis — not just producing assets on request.



If you are someone who wants to grow with a company and eventually lead a function, not just fill a role, this is the opportunity.

 VA

title: Operations & Project Manager (Comic Books-Full Time)
description:
Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 3 years with us is worth 10 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your peers by being on this team. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!



If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 



We don’t need another task hopper. Looking for a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked



We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



Who This Is NOT For

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market 

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure



Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth



Start: $800/mo PH based, full time during a 30–60 day trial.

When you consistently hit our KPIs (25 meaningful tasks/week with proof, D3 standards, owns Slack/Asana, Culture score), total comp moves to $900–$1,000/mo.



High performers who carry more scope over time can earn $1,100–$1,200+ with expanded responsibility.



Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs, & raising the standard, not time served

If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. No ceiling. This is what you make it. 



How To Apply

Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):



Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion without delegating. What tools did you use to track it, what were the exact deliverables, and what was the measurable result?

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.



Also attach your PDF/Googledrive resume link



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

title: US Tax Preparer / Accountant
description:
Job Description

Part-Time Tax Preparer / Accountant



Job Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, Eastern Time (schedule to be finalized; this role may extend beyond 20 hours per week during tax season, depending on business needs)



Tax Season Hours (January 1 to April 15): 50-60 hours per week



Salary: $800/m



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Tax Preparer / Accountant to support a growing U.S.-based accounting practice. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with a strong background in U.S. tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial operations support. The successful candidate will assist with tax compliance, monthly bookkeeping, account reconciliations, payroll support, and occasional administrative tasks such as client onboarding. This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential for increased hours as the business grows, and will scale to approximately 60 hours per week during peak tax season (January through April 15). The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, tech-savvy, and able to work independently in a remote environment while managing deadlines effectively.



Key Responsibilities:



• Prepare and assist with U.S. individual and business tax returns accurately and in a timely manner

• Perform monthly bookkeeping tasks using QuickBooks

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and general ledger accounts

• Maintain accurate financial records and support month-end accounting processes

• Assist with payroll processing and related administrative tasks as needed

• Organize tax documents, prepare working papers, and ensure completeness of client financial data

• Support onboarding of new clients, including gathering documentation and setting up client records

• Provide light administrative support related to accounting operations and client management

• Communicate proactively regarding deadlines, outstanding items, and client information requirements

• Adapt to evolving workflows and new accounting/tax software platforms as the practice grows

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency in recurring accounting and tax processes



Required Skills & Qualifications:



• 2+ years of experience in tax preparation, accounting, or bookkeeping

• Strong experience preparing U.S. individual and/or business tax returns

• Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online and/or Desktop)

• Solid understanding of bookkeeping, account reconciliations, accounting principles, and month-end accounting processes

• Experience with payroll processing is an advantage

• Experience with Intuit ProConnect or similar U.S. tax software is a plus

• Experience working with U.S.-based accounting firms, CPA firms, or tax practices preferred

• Familiarity with client onboarding workflows and administrative support within a professional services environment is a plus

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial work

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, especially during peak tax periods

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tax, accounting, and practice management software

• Ability to work independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision
